purpose: Fixed original grid ledger attribution before any new grid/state rule
method: FIFO effective cash cost per NET received BTC, cash proceeds after sell fee; daily equity minus initial equals cumulative realized plus marked unrealized. Buy fee paid in BTC embedded in net quantity, no double fee subtraction.
limits: Original fills omit cell_id; FIFO attribution is accounting convention, not proof of per-grid paired cycle profit. Fee/fill assumptions inherit original model. No state fitting or future winner slicing.
